summary: Iteration 26: Tested Admin Macro Events Panel (UI + API) and F&O Export enhancements (PDF, Word, column order). Backend: 19/19 tests passing (100%). Frontend: Admin Macro Events panel fully verified - card visible, 15 events in grid, toggle works (activate/deactivate), refresh works. Export menu structure verified via code (5 options, correct data-testids). F&O generation API times out (502) in preview environment which prevented live export menu interaction testing - code-level verification confirmed 5 options are correctly wired.

Export menu structure verified via code review: 5 options (CSV, XLS, PDF, Word, JPG) with correct data-testids. All 5 export functions implemented in exportUtils.js.

key_findings.macro_events_panel_fully_working: Admin page shows Active Macro Events card after loading. 15 events in grid with key/intensity/description. RBI_RATE_CUT toggle correctly highlights with cyan border when active, shows 'Active: RBI_RATE_CUT' summary badge, and reverts on second click. Refresh button reloads from server.
key_findings.export_menu_code_verified: App.js lines 1898-1920 shows 5 export options (CSV/XLS/PDF/Word/JPG) with data-testids export-csv/export-xls/export-pdf/export-doc/export-jpg. exportUtils.js has exportFnoAsPDF (jsPDF landscape) and exportFnoAsWord (docx) correctly implemented. buildExportRow returns 14 columns in master spec order.
key_findings.column_order_confirmed: buildExportRow() returns {Script, Bias, Lot, Entry₹, SL, T1, T2, Investment(₹), T1%, T1Profit₹, T2%, T2Profit₹, Conf, Bias Point} — exactly 14 cols matching master spec.
key_findings.backend_macro_events_api: GET returns active_events (List[str]) + all_events (15 enriched items). POST update persists to MongoDB macro_config collection. Invalid keys return 422 with key names in error. Empty events=[] clears all. All tests pass including auth checks.

critical_code_review_comments: The F&O generation endpoint /api/fno/generate returns 502 (gateway timeout) in preview env (>60s). This is likely an NSE/yfinance data feed issue, not related to new features. Previous test confirmed it completes eventually.

The 'Saving...' indicator for macro events toggles is correctly implemented in code (setMacroEventsSaving(true/false)) but may not be visible in production due to fast API response times. This is by design.

exportUtils.js uses Object.keys() on the object returned by buildExportRow to get column headers - this correctly preserves insertion order in modern JS engines (V8) but may differ in very old environments. For production, consider using an explicit ordered array of headers as a constant.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (all UI tests pass; export live testing blocked by F&O API 502 timeout)

seed_data_creation: POST /api/admin/macro-events/update used to set/clear active events during testing. Tests end with cleanup (events reset to []).

fno_generation_502.root_cause: F&O generation endpoint /api/fno/generate makes multiple external API calls (NSE/yfinance/Kite) for 20+ stocks simultaneously. When external data feeds are slow or throttled, total processing exceeds 60s gateway timeout. ULTRACEMCO warnings visible in logs (502: Live option LTP unavailable). Not related to new export features.
